sentences.en: After the conflict there were many dead on both sides.
We have to avoid a conflict as far as possible.
sentences.zh: 我们必须尽可能避免冲突。

sentences.en: It is costly and politically difficult to continue this conflict.
sentences.zh: 继续这场争端代价高昂且在政治上非常困难。

senses.zh: 冲突，争执；战争，战斗；矛盾，不一致
冲突，抵触；不一致，相矛盾

mnemonic: 词根记忆：con（共同）+flict（打）→互相打→冲突
